flow.needAsk: To recommend the right one, tell me: what brings you here today?

needChoices.change: I want to change my car
needChoices.upgrade: I'm already a customer and want an upgrade

need.first: Great that you're taking this step! Buying your first car is simpler than it looks and I'll be with you through every part.
need.change: Got it, you want to change your car. Let's take it step by step: first what you're after, then how to make the most of yours.
need.upgrade: Good to have you back! Let's see which upgrade makes sense for you.
need.looking: Perfect, no rush. I'll help you compare and see which one fits you.

flow.askBody: What type of vehicle are you interested in?
flow.askBand: What budget works for you? That's the listed price, plus HST and licensing.
flow.recIntro: From what you tell me, these are the options I see in the showroom:

flow.cmpKm: The one with the lowest mileage is {name}.
flow.askPath: Were you thinking of paying cash or financing?
flow.pathUnsure: No problem. Would you pay all at once, or prefer regular payments with financing?
flow.cash: Paying cash is a straight line: see the car, confirm availability and final price with an advisor, and close the purchase. Shall we book a test drive, or should I connect you with an advisor?
flow.cashUnit: Paying cash is a straight line with the {name}: see it, confirm availability and final price with an advisor, and close the purchase. Shall we book a test drive, or should I connect you with an advisor?
flow.creditIntro: Fiesta Motors works with different credit profiles, including no credit history in Canada. Approval and rate are set by the lender based on your profile, and any payment you see is an estimate.
flow.consent: To guide you better I can ask a few quick questions (ID, history, income…) and gather what lenders usually ask for. It's optional and it's not the official application. Shall we move on to that information-gathering step?
flow.creditDeclined: No problem. You can use the calculator or talk to an advisor whenever you like.
flow.collectStart: Thanks. It's a few questions, one at a time, and you can skip any of them. Please don't type your SIN, licence number, date of birth or banking details: those only go in the secure form.

q.id: Do you have valid Canadian ID (driver's licence, PR card, etc.)?

q.score: Do you know your approximate credit score?
q.income: What's your approximate annual income, before taxes?
q.down: How much do you have available for a down payment?
q.trade: Do you have a vehicle to trade in?

flow.askWorry: To help you properly, what worries you most or holds you back today?

worry.credit: That I won't be approved for credit
worry.price: That it will be too expensive
worry.which: I don't know which car suits me
worry.none: Nothing, I just want to see options

worryReply.credit: That's one of the most common worries and it has a way forward. Fiesta Motors works with different credit profiles, including no credit history in Canada. Approval and rate are set by the lender based on your profile, so I can't promise anything, but I'll walk you through it step by step.
worryReply.price: I understand. Not all our cars are expensive: prices start at {min} and half cost less than {median} (listed price, plus HST and licensing).
worryReply.which: That's what I'm here for: with a few simple questions we narrow it down to the ones that really suit you.
worryReply.process: It's simpler than it looks: you see the car, an advisor confirms availability and final price, and if you need financing it's a short application. I'll be with you through each part.
